title: Kissed Springy Jamaican Celeriac Stew
description: A winey and indulgent Jamaican dish featuring celeriac, this stew is perfect for a cold evening, simmered in a nimono style to bring out the flavors of the ingredients. It is gluten-free-friendly, making it accessible to a wide range of dietary needs.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cubed celeriac and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the red wine, coconut milk, scotch bonnet peppers, thyme, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir the stew occasionally as it simmers to prevent the ingredients from sticking to the bottom of the pot.
After 20 minutes, remove the pot from the heat and let the stew cool slightly before serving.
